paragraphs.text: DSH Web 对话隐私遮罩：提问与回答默认模糊、悬停才显示 / Blur the questions and answers in the DeepSeek Harness Web conversa
tion until the pointer rests on them
# DSH Chat Privacy Blur · 对话隐私遮罩
A display-layer privacy guard for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI: every question and every answe
r in the conversation is drawn blurred, and only the row under the pointer shows its original text.
Made for an open-plan office, a shared screen, or a screen recording.
DSH Web 对话的显示层隐私遮挡：提问与回答一律画成模糊，鼠标停在哪一条，才显示那一条的原文。给工位旁边有人、共享屏幕、或者正在录屏的时候用。
## Features / 功能
- Blurs the question and answer rows by default; hovering (or keyboard focus) reveals that one row a

nd re-blurs it when the pointer leaves.
- 默认全部模糊，鼠标停在哪一条显示哪一条；键盘 Tab 聚焦进某条同样显示，移开立即恢复模糊。
- Leaving t
he window (Alt+Tab, another app, a hidden tab) withdraws the reveal at once: the mask becomes `Alway
s blurred` until the window is focused again, so a row you left the pointer on is never readable beh

ind your back.
- 离开窗口（Alt+Tab、切到别的应用、标签页被隐藏）立刻收回显示：遮罩临时变成「始终模糊」，回到窗口才恢复你选的模式——指针停在某条上也不会留在那里露着。
- On
e control below the composer cycles three modes — `Off` / `Hover to reveal` / `Always blurred` — and

the choice is remembered per browser.
- 输入框下方一个按钮循环切换三档：`关闭` / `悬停显示` / `始终模糊`，选择按浏览器记住，换会话、重开窗口都保持

。
- Only drawn pixels change: message text, copy actions, `/` commands and the model input keep thei

r original characters, and the stylesheet is added and removed with the control.
- 只改画出来的像素：正文、复制、模型

输入都保持原样；样式表跟着控件挂载与卸载，不留全局残留。
- Follows the host theme (`--dsw-alias-*` tokens), light and dark, and

both interface languages.
- 跟随宿主主题令牌与界面语言，浅色/深色都对。
## Modes / 三种模式
| Mode / 模式 | Behaviour / 行为 |

| 关闭 · Off | Nothing is masked; identical to a host without the plugin. |
| 悬停显示 · Hover to reveal (
default) | All rows blurred; the hovered or focused row shows its text, withheld while the window is

unfocused. |
| 始终模糊 · Always blurred | All rows stay blurred, even under the pointer. |
The mode is stored in `localStorage` under `dsh-chat-privacy-blur:mode`. Clearing it falls back to `

hover`.
模式存在 `localStorage` 的 `dsh-chat-privacy-blur:mode`，删掉就回到默认的「悬停显示」。
### Focus lock / 失焦上锁
A hover or keyboard reveal is a pointer/focus state, and that state outlives the window losing focus
: the row you left the cursor on — or one whose copy button still holds focus — would stay readable
while you look at something else. So while the window is unfocused or the page is hidden, the mask i
s drawn as `Always blurred`, the control reports the lock in its tooltip, and the chosen mode return
s with the focus. `Off` stays off: a mask you turned off is never forced back on.
悬停和键盘聚焦都是「指针/焦点状态」，而这两种状态在窗口失去焦点后依然成立：你指针停留的那条、或某个刚被点过的按钮所在的那条，会一直露着。所以窗口失焦或页面被隐藏时，遮罩改画成「始终模糊」，控件在提示
里说明已上锁，回到窗口再恢复你选的模式。`关闭` 就是关闭：被关掉的遮罩不会被强行打开。
## What is blurred / 模糊范围
Masked rows are selected by the conversation row attributes the host already publishes for its own l
rows are selected by the conversation row attributes the host already publishes for its own layout:
| Row attribute / 行属性 | Content / 内容 |

| `data-chat-flow-kind="user"` | your question / 你发的问题 |
| `data-chat-flow-kind="assistant-step"` |

the assistant reply, including the compacted answer row / 助手回答，含折叠成小卡的最终回答 |
| `data-chat-flow-kind=
"steering"` | input injected mid-turn / 回合进行中插入的补充输入 |
Not masked: tool-call cards, the reasoning wrapper, the sidebar session list, the composer, `/goal`

bar and the turn previews.
不遮挡：工具调用卡片、思考过程外层、侧边栏会话列表、输入框、`/goal` 输入条与轮次预览。
If a future host renames those row attributes, nothing gets blurred — the plugin degrades to doing n

othing rather than breaking the page.
如果宿主以后改了这些行属性名，插件会退化成"什么都不糊"，不会弄坏页面。
## Install / 安装
In DSH, ask your agent / 在 DSH 中对 AI 说：
> 安装插件 https://github.com/outmanwt/dsh-chat-privacy-blur/releases/latest/download/dsh-chat-privacy-b
https://github.com/outmanwt/dsh-chat-privacy-blur/releases/latest/download/dsh-chat-privacy-blur.tgz
Or use the plugin-manager tool with these arguments / 也可调用插件管理工具，参数：
[代码示例省略，未执行]
For CLI-managed profiles / 对于自行管理的 CLI profile：
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Desktop users should install through their running app's plugin manager, not an unrelated `web` prof

ile. Follow the installation result for refresh/restart instructions.
[该节后续省略]
## Compatibility / 兼容说明
Developed against DSH `0.2.1-rc.4` (desktop, Web GUI). Uses the client module loader, one `conversat
ion.composer.dock` entry, the `locale` dictionary registry, and the host's own conversation row attr
ibutes. Older or newer hosts are unverified; the mask is a stylesheet only, so a host change costs t

he blur, not the page.
在 DSH `0.2.1-rc.4`（桌面版 Web GUI）上开发。依赖客户端模块加载器、`conversation.composer.dock` 一个
槽位、`locale` 词条注册，以及宿主自己的对话行属性。其他版本未验证；遮罩只是样式表，宿主改版最坏情况是"不再模糊"，不会影响页面。
## Privacy / 数据
No network requests, no analytics, no credential access, no host state. The mode lives in the page's
`localStorage`; the plugin reads nothing from the session. Masking is visual: text stays in the DOM
and can still be selected, copied, or read by assistive technology, so it is not an access control.
不联网、不埋点、不碰凭据、不写宿主状态；模式只存在页面 `localStorage`，插件不读取会话内容。遮挡只是视觉层：文字仍在 DOM 里，仍可选中、复制、被辅助技术读到，所以它不是访问控制。
